title: New Zealand/Antarctica/Australia
content: The transit station in Mall World. If I get there in time WITH my passport, it's a weird open air/glass ceiling plane. And it's ALWAYS me trying to fly to the southern hemisphere. The time difference is always in the forefront of the dream. I saw a few pics from the NZ airport and it took my breath away. Because that's exactly what I've seen in Mall World. Anyone here stuck on an old old phone (Blackberry for me) and it works better than your smartphone (if you can find it lol)? PS. I've never left North America IRL.
